name: Clallam Transit Interlink
note: Two separate service zones (~3 sq mi each) centered in Sequim and Forks; replaced fixed-route service; system has non-contiguous coverage. CSV pin (48.08, -123.43) sits ~midway between the two zones (they are ~110 km apart along US-101), so it reads as far from either circle -- this is a CSV pin-placement artifact, not a boundary error; source: clallamtransit.com

name: CONNECT (Ben Franklin Transit)
note: Tri-Cities service area; six zones within central Kennewick, Richland, and Pasco; connects to fixed-route network with 3-hour transfer window

name: Cowlitz Tribe Transit Service
note: Text specifies South Lewis County (Centralia area) and Cowlitz County, up to 20 miles from the I-5 corridor -- not the full extent of either county; approximated as two 20-mile (32.18 km) radius circles centered on Centralia and Longview along I-5, clipped to Lewis and Cowlitz counties. Source: cowlitz.org/transit

name: HarborFlex (Dial-A-Ride)
note: Dial-a-ride (non-paratransit) service across five communities in Grays Harbor County; Tokeland and Ocean Shores weekdays only

name: Kitsap Transit On-Demand (Ride Pingo)
note: Five named zones (BI Ride/Bainbridge Island, Kingston Ride, SK Ride/South Kitsap, Purdy Ride, Nollwood Dial-A-Ride); scheduling varies by zone; exact boundaries not specified

name: Metro Flex
note: ~100 sq mi microtransit service area unified from three prior pilots; exact zone boundaries not specified

name: Pierce Transit Runner
note: 5 named zones (Spanaway North/South, Puyallup, Tideflats, Ruston) plus Gig Harbor corridor; exact zone boundaries not specified; service spans Pierce County

name: STA Link
note: Planned pilot zones: North Spokane Valley, Latah Valley, Liberty Lake, West Plains, Northeast Spokane (incl. Mead); not yet launched as of Sept 2026

name: The Current (C-TRAN)
note: Multiple zones: WSU Vancouver/Salmon Creek, Rose Village, Camas/Washougal, Port of Vancouver, Ridgefield/La Center, Battle Ground; exact boundaries not specified

name: Zip Shuttle (Community Transit)
note: Multiple service zones across Snohomish County; Alderwood zone is in Lynnwood; Darrington, Arlington, Lake Stevens added as separate pilot zones in late 2024
